OUR STORY IN BRIEF

Not just a shawl.
A living piece of history.

The Weaving Co. was born from one conviction — that the finest textiles in the world belong in your wardrobe, not behind glass in a museum. We work directly with artisan families in Amritsar, paying fair wages, preserving dying crafts, and bringing you shawls, stoles, scarves, cashmere & pashminas that carry centuries of tradition in every thread.

Our story

Born in Amritsar.
Made for the world.

We didn't start a business. We started a mission — to keep a 300-year-old craft alive, fairly and beautifully.

How The Weaving Co. began

It started on a winter trip to Srinagar. Walking through the old city, I stumbled into a workshop where an old craftsman sat at a loom, his fingers moving with the quiet confidence of someone who had done this ten thousand times. He was making a Kani shawl — a process that takes three months. He told me he earned less per shawl than most people spend on a meal.

I came home and couldn't stop thinking about it. There had to be a way to connect people who appreciate genuine craft with the people who create it. The Weaving Co. is that bridge — a direct line from the looms of Amritsar to your wardrobe, with nothing in between except honesty.

Frequently asked questions
How do I know the pashmina is authentic?
Every piece comes with a GI (Geographical Indication) tag and Woolmark certification. We also include a certificate of authenticity naming the artisan who made your shawl.
Do you offer cash on delivery?
Yes — COD is available across India on all orders. You can also pay via UPI, credit/debit cards, EMI, and all major digital wallets.
What is your return policy?
We offer hassle-free 15-day returns on all unworn, unwashed items in original packaging. Just contact us and we'll arrange a free pickup.
Can I get gift wrapping?
Absolutely. Free gift wrap and a personalised handwritten note is available on every order — just add your message at checkout.

Help centre

Shipping & delivery

Every order is packed by hand at our facility in Amritsar and shipped across India and internationally.

Processing time

Orders are processed and dispatched within 1–2 business days. During sale periods or festive season, processing can take up to 3 business days. You'll receive an email with your tracking details as soon as your order ships.

Delivery timelines
Within India
3–5 business days to metro cities, 5–7 business days elsewhere. Shipping is free on all domestic orders, prepaid or COD.
International
10–15 business days depending on destination. Customs duties and import taxes, if any, are the responsibility of the customer and are collected by the courier on delivery.
Tracking your order

Once your order ships you'll get a tracking link by email and SMS. You can also use our Track your order page any time, or WhatsApp us at +91 98765 43210 with your order ID.

Help centre

Returns & refunds

We want you to love what you ordered. If it's not right, here's how returns work.

15-day return window

You can return any unworn, unwashed item in its original packaging with tags attached within 15 days of delivery. Made-to-order and customised pieces cannot be returned unless faulty.

How to start a return
Step 1
Email hello@theweavingco.in or WhatsApp +91 98765 43210 with your order ID and reason for return.
Step 2
We'll arrange a free pickup from your address within 2–4 business days.
Step 3
Once the item passes quality check, your refund is processed within 5–7 business days to your original payment method (or as store credit, your choice).
Exchanges

Want a different colour or size instead? Mention it when you contact us and we'll ship the replacement as soon as the returned item is picked up, subject to availability.

How do I know the pashmina is authentic?

Privacy policy

How The Weaving Co. collects, uses, and protects your information.

What we collect

When you shop with us, we collect information you provide directly — name, email, phone number, shipping address, and order details. We do not store your full card details; payments are processed securely by our payment partner.

How we use it

We use your information to process and deliver orders, send order and shipping updates, respond to enquiries, and — only with your consent — send you news about new collections and offers. We never sell your personal data.

Sharing with third parties

We share the minimum necessary information with trusted partners who help us operate: payment processing, courier and logistics partners for delivery, and email providers for order updates. Each is bound to use your data only for that purpose.

Cookies & analytics

We use cookies to keep your shopping bag working between pages and, with your consent, to understand how visitors find and use this site — for example, how many people visit, roughly where from, which pages and products they look at, and whether they arrived from a link we shared on Instagram or elsewhere. This is done using aggregate, anonymised analytics tools. We do not use cookies to learn your name or identity — the only way we know who you are is if you tell us yourself, such as by placing an order or messaging us. You can decline analytics cookies at any time from the banner shown on your first visit.

Your rights

You can request a copy of the data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, at any time by emailing hello@theweavingco.in.
